biotronik_orsiro_mission.maker: Biotronik (Vascular Intervention business acquired by Teleflex, effective 2025-07-01)
biotronik_orsiro_mission.product: Orsiro Mission sirolimus-eluting coronary stent system (ultrathin strut, hybrid DES with proBIO + BIOlute PLLA)
biotronik_orsiro_mission.generation_notes: Orsiro Mission is the current-generation Orsiro (new delivery system, 140 cm, 2.7F/2.9F distal shaft, RBP 16 atm). Older plain 'Orsiro' (Orsiro, magenta carton too) is the previous delivery system.

sizes.matrix_notes: 2.25 mm: 9-30; 2.5/2.75/3.0/3.5/4.0 mm: 9-40 (all 9 lengths); 4.5 and 5.0 mm: 9-30. Inventory sizes 2.25-4.0 x 15-40 are consistent.
sizes.other: Fast exchange, 0.014" wire, 5F guide (2.25-4.0) / 6F (4.5-5.0), distal shaft 2.7F (2.25-3.0) / 2.9F (3.5-5.0), NP 10 atm (11 for 4.5-5.0), RBP 16 atm. Some sizes may be market-specific.

biotronik_orsiro_mission.ref_scheme: 6-digit Biotronik REF; sequential per length within a diameter (45392x-45397x for 2.25-4.0; 47369x for 4.5-5.0). Older Orsiro REFs are 4017xx/4046xx.

carton.basis: not found (no published unit-carton dimensions/weight located; only photo estimates in the inventory)

images.shows: Straight-on carton face (US-labelled, plain Orsiro not Mission, REF 404676): white square carton, magenta header band with 'Orsiro' and size box, BIOTRONIK logo bottom right. Square-ish face, not the thin spine.

biotronik_orsiro_mission.inventory_corrections: None; identification confirmed. Product is the current Orsiro Mission. Carton shown in the only photo found is the older Orsiro label (US), square face.

biotronik_red_blue_unknown.generation_notes: Not Pantera LEO (its carton has a gold/orange band and 'NC' box, see image). Not Orsiro/Orsiro Mission (magenta). Not Passeo (maroon/red band, PTA). Pantera LEO and Pantera Pro sizes do not match the seen 2.25/2.75 and 14/19/23-33/38 mm lengths (LEO: 8,12,15,20,30; Pantera Pro: 6-30; Pantera Lux DCB: 10-30).

sizes.matrix_notes: Not determinable. Seen sizes (2.25-3.5 x 14/19/23-33/38) do not match any Biotronik coronary range found. Lengths 14/19/24/29/33/36 resemble Biosensors Chroma; 15/18/23/28/33/38 resemble COMBO Plus, so the box may be misattributed or a non-Biotronik red/blue carton, or a Biotronik market-specific stent (e.g. PRO-Kinetic Energy, lengths 9-35, red/blue not verified).
